ChatAssistant.name: StyleMatch Assistant
ChatAssistant.dragHint: Drag me anywhere · Tap to chat
ChatAssistant.welcome: Hi! I’m your shopping assistant. I can help you find the right style, check delivery details, or answer questions about your order.
ChatAssistant.placeholder: Ask about products, delivery, or returns…
ChatAssistant.disclaimer: AI assistant · Please verify important order details

responses.findStyle: I’d love to help. Tell me what you’re shopping for, your preferred colours, and the occasion—and I’ll narrow down some styles for you.
responses.delivery: Standard delivery is free on orders over $50. Delivery timing and any faster options are shown at checkout for your address.
responses.returns: You can return eligible items within 30 days. Keep the item unworn with its tags attached, then visit Shipping & Returns for the steps.
responses.fallback: Thanks for your message. This assistant is currently in preview mode, so I can guide you around the store but can’t access live products or orders yet.
